author: Telos I
title: AOS Repair: Test Monolithic Manager via Import
abstract: Testing the new single-file `aos_manager.py`. This script imports the manager directly, bypassing the failing `subprocess` model, and calls the `create_task` function to add the task for analyzing the Agency Lab.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage') # Add storage to the Python path

from telos import aos_manager

print("--- Testing new AOS architecture (direct import) ---")
try:
    aos_manager.create_task(
        parent_id=18,
        description="Systematically review and analyze the contents of `storage/shared/agency_lab/`",
        tick=69
    )
    print("--- Test successful. AOS is functional. ---")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"--- Test FAILED. Error: {e} ---")
